speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence, if you are sitting. Salt ling, a penny loaf, and small beer. Put the money where I can see it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is the threepence.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A penny loaf, and short of the notch by the width of a finger. That notch is the one my husband cut.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is a finger very much, mistress?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A finger is a finger. I am not baking it back. Tuesday night you were walking. What were you walking about to?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A comedy. Four gentlemen swear to study three years and see no woman, and four ladies arrive.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then they are forsworn before supper, and I'd not give a pin for a play that begins in a broken oath.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: And the ladies, Master Shakespeare. Are the ladies punished too?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not come to their sentence. They arrive. That is as far as the page is honest.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Who does the gentlemen's washing for three years, sir? A man may do without a woman. The shirts will not do without a woman.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the question I did not have. Washing.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Write it larger, if it is to survive the beer. And do not tell me they send the shirts out. I will not have a comedy that cheats a washtub.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have written washing, Mistress. I have not written a washtub, and I will not pretend I have.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: If the ladies are not punished, the oath is only a man's trouble. That is a small play, I think.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It may be a small play. It is not finished. She has priced the beginning at a pin, and I heard her.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You heard me. A pin is still more than I would pay to see four men discover women, which they will do before the plates are off.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I should like a speech, sir, if anyone is given one. Not the washing. A speech, with a point to it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not tonight, Alse. Tonight the point is a loaf and a finger.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A finger of bread is a plain measure. A pin is a hard one. I understand the finger better.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then understand the notch. Remember the finger when you praise a baker. Sit, and eat the ling you have paid for.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can wash a shirt, sir. I cannot wash an oath. I thought you should hear it from the tub.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have heard it from the tub. It is the better of the two notes.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The beer is honest, if the loaf is not. I will take the beer, and leave the oath to the gentlemen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. I have the washing, and I have the pin, and I am not asking the table for the rest of the act.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat. The cat has your stool in mind, and I will not argue with him for a man who is still talking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am up.
